key_insight: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO adapts the risk coefficient across diffusion denoising states, making RLVR training more effective for dLLMs by improving both accuracy and diversity.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical training control knob for diffusion language models, with scheduling choices that can be tuned to trade off exploration, stability, and reasoning quality in real deployments.
method: Vary the GRPO risk coefficient by denoising step instead of using one fixed setting.
For binary rewards, reinterpret the transformation as prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered advantages.
Use calibration plus endpoint/interpolation ablations to choose an effective coefficient schedule.
evidence_signal: Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improved pass@1 and pass@k over centered GRPO while also increasing answer diversity.
watch_item: The gains depend on careful schedule design and calibration, so the method may require extra tuning and validation when transferred to new backbones or reward settings.
paper_title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
